욥기 22:1.content: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

욥기 22:2.content: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

욥기 22:3.content: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?

욥기 22:4.content: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

욥기 22:5.content: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?

욥기 22:6.content: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

욥기 22:7.content: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

욥기 22:8.content: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.

욥기 22:9.content: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

욥기 22:10.content: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

욥기 22:11.content: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

욥기 22:12.content: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

욥기 22:13.content: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

욥기 22:14.content: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

욥기 22:15.content: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

욥기 22:16.content: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

욥기 22:17.content: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

욥기 22:18.content: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

욥기 22:19.content: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

욥기 22:20.content: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.

욥기 22:21.content: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

욥기 22:22.content: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

욥기 22:23.content: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

욥기 22:24.content: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

욥기 22:25.content: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.

욥기 22:26.content: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.

욥기 22:27.content: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

욥기 22:28.content: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

욥기 22:29.content: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.

욥기 22:30.content: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
